in_english.name: Zainoor
in_english.meaning: meaning: womb, mercy, bounty, goodness, relief
in_english.long_meaning: Zainoor is a name of Allah that means womb, mercy, bounty, goodness, and relief. It is one of the names of Allah that signify His mercy and kindness. The name Zainoor is derived from the Arabic root letter Z-N-R which means to be safe, to be protected, and to be guided. In Islamic tradition, the name Zainoor is considered to be a blessing from Allah and is often given to newborn babies as a sign of gratitude and thankfulness.
